howItWorks.title: How KrishiSaathi Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Turn your complex soil lab test into actionable farming decisions in under two minutes.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Take a photo or upload a PDF of your government Soil Health Card or lab test report.
howItWorks.step2Desc: Our platform extracts N, P, K, pH, organic carbon, and micronutrients like Zinc and Sulphur automatically.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Get exact bag quantities per acre for Urea, DAP, and MOP with application timings tailored to your plot size.
howItWorks.step4Desc: Tap the microphone to ask questions in your language and listen to audio replies from your agricultural AI assistant.
howItWorks.uploadBtn: Upload Soil Report to Get Started

features.title: Comprehensive Soil & Agronomy Intelligence
features.subtitle: Combining modern data science with agricultural standards to maximize harvest yield and lower input costs.
features.card1Desc: Digitize paper Soil Health Cards in seconds without tedious manual data entry.
features.card2Desc: Avoid unnecessary expenditure on fertilizers like Potash when soil reserves are already ample, saving ₹2,000 to ₹4,000 per acre.
features.card3Desc: Recommends certified seed varieties matching your soil pH, texture, and seasonal water availability.
features.card4Sub: Speak and Listen in Your Language
features.card4Desc: Designed for accessibility. Ask questions via voice input and listen to synthesized audio advice.
features.card5Desc: Identifies critical Zinc, Sulphur, and Boron shortages before yield losses or crop diseases occur.
features.card6Desc: All fertilizer ratios and crop parameters align with verified agronomic standards.

whyChoose.title: Built for Farmers, Rooted in Agricultural Realities
whyChoose.subtitle: Generic agricultural software often gives theoretical recommendations in complex units. KrishiSaathi translates soil data into practical bags per acre, saving costs and preserving long-term soil health.
whyChoose.point1Desc: Calculates exact commercial fertilizer bags (45 kg Urea, 50 kg DAP) per acre directly tailored to your plot size.
whyChoose.point2Desc: Recommends organic carbon enhancements (FYM and green manure) alongside chemical fertilizers to rebuild soil biology.
whyChoose.point3Desc: Voice-guided AI allows farmers to speak their doubts and receive spoken audio replies.

fpo.title: Field-Tested Workflow for FPOs & Agri Staff
